---
title: Caption alignment
format:
  preprint-typst:
    keep-typ: true
syntax-highlighting: github
---

All captions should align the same way relative to the text column.

::: {#fig-narrow}
{{< placeholder 150 80 format=svg >}}

A narrow figure with a caption that is long enough to wrap onto a second line of text in the column.
:::

| A | B |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |

: A narrow table with a caption that is long enough to wrap onto a second line of text in the column. {#tbl-narrow}

```{#lst-short .r lst-cap="A short listing with a long caption that is very long, long enough to wrap onto a second line of text."}
x <- 1
```

Wide table:

| Column one | Column two | Column three | Column four | Column five | Column six |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| a | b | c | d | e | f |

: A wide table. {#tbl-wide}

Short captions:

::: {#fig-short}
{{< placeholder 150 80 format=svg >}}

Short figure caption.
:::

| A | B |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |

: Short table caption. {#tbl-short}

```{#lst-short2 .r lst-cap="Short listing caption."}
x <- 1
```

A long code line wraps within the column:

```r
some_very_long_function_name <- function(the_first_long_argument = a_default_value) {
  NA
}
```
